observations: Black PlayStation 4 console with Star Wars branding and Imperial crest design
"PS4" text visible on the right side, "STAR WARS" on the front lower edge
Two black controllers resting on top of the console
Power cable and HDMI cable visible beside the console
UK-style power sockets on the blue wall behind
"POSTED ON JIJI" and "GAME ARENA OFFICIAL" watermarks over the image
Console has a slanted profile but the model label is not readable

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows PS4 text but not the Pro designation

risks.risk: It may be a PS4 Slim or Fat rather than a Pro
risks.proof: clear photo of the model label on the rear or base
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard PS4, not a Pro

risks.risk: Console may not power on or work
risks.proof: video of the console booting to the home screen
video showing each port tested with a device
video of extended gameplay or a thermal check

risks.risk: Console may have been opened or repaired
risks.proof: close-up photos of warranty seals and screws

risks.risk: UK receipt may not exist or be genuine

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model label on the back or base to confirm PS4 Pro
Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen
Close-up photos of the console screws and seals to confirm it was never opened
response.reason: The photos show a PlayStation 4 console with two controllers, so it can be priced at its worst case as a standard used PS4 even though the Pro model and working condition are unproven.
